status: exploratory (pre-registered criterion; one controlled model change)
hypothesis: A small L2-regularised logistic regression that combines the weak, individually consistent effects found in E002-E008 (short-horizon reversal in momentum, volume and taker-buy share; contrarian funding; dollar/yield 5-day changes; with volatility and trade intensity as conditioning inputs, plus the baseline category scores) produces a directional signal that is stable out-of-sample under walk-forward validation, where the fixed-weight scoring 0.1.0 does not.
acceptance_criterion: PRE-REGISTERED. On the concatenated out-of-sample predictions of the expanding walk-forward (purge = H, embargo 24h, quarterly test blocks, >= 365 days of training), the model 'adds a stable signal at horizon H' only if ALL hold in BOTH the exploration-OOS (test blocks before 2024) and validation-OOS (2024-01 -> 2025-06) periods: (1) acted-direction accuracy > the naive rate max(base, 1-base) on the same rows; (2) the edge (mean forward return when p > 0.5 minus when p < 0.5) has a block-bootstrap 95% interval excluding zero; (3) Brier score below the base-rate Brier. Three horizons are tested as three fixed, separately reported tests (1h, 6h, 24h) -- not a search; a pass at one horizon is a finding for that horizon only. The rolling layout is a robustness check, reported, never used to choose. TRIPWIRE: acted accuracy > 0.60 or Brier < 0.24 at 24h is treated as suspicious and investigated before being recorded.
scoring_version: 0.1.0 (untouched; baseline evaluated on identical test rows)

model.type: logistic regression, L2 penalty, C = 0.1 (fixed in advance, no search)
model.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted on each fold's training rows only

target.outcome: close of candle opening at as_of+H

validation_design: expanding walk-forward, min_train 365d, test blocks 90d, purge H, embargo 24h; rolling 730d as robustness
notes: Six runs total (2 feature sets x 3 horizons) on the primary layout, plus rolling robustness; all reported. Nothing about the live system changes regardless of outcome.
